$about: Everything the quests say: each one's name, summary, badge and finishing line, and every step's instruction, reason and hint. Edit the text freely. Words in {curly} brackets are filled in by the app, so keep them, spelled the same. The steps themselves (what counts as done, what to ring) stay in code. npm run words:apply merges edits in and refuses a lost placeholder.

quest.camera-move.title.where: Quest "Camera move": its name, on the welcome sheet, in the Quests panel and on the Great work card.

quest.camera-move.summary.text: Pan a camera across a valley, with far hills that drift slower.
quest.camera-move.summary.where: Quest "Camera move": the one friendly sentence under its name, on the welcome sheet and in the Quests panel.

quest.camera-move.badge.where: Quest "Camera move": the name of the badge you earn for finishing it.

quest.camera-move.finish.text: That's a real camera move with parallax. Exports always see what the camera sees.
quest.camera-move.finish.where: Quest "Camera move": the line on the Great work card once you have finished it.

quest.camera-move.add.say.text: Add a camera: Frames and motion > Camera > Add a camera.
quest.camera-move.add.say.where: Quest "Camera move", step 1 (add): what the guide says.

quest.camera-move.add.why.text: The camera is a layer of its own. Its frame shows what an export will show.
quest.camera-move.add.why.where: Quest "Camera move", step 1 (add): the quiet line under it saying why.

quest.camera-move.add.hint.text: The Camera panel on the right has an Add a camera button too.
quest.camera-move.add.hint.where: Quest "Camera move", step 1 (add): said when nothing has happened for a while.

quest.camera-move.move.say.text: This is the last frame. Drag the camera frame to the right, over the house.
quest.camera-move.move.say.where: Quest "Camera move", step 2 (move): what the guide says.

quest.camera-move.move.why.text: Moving the camera on another frame gives that frame a camera key of its own.
quest.camera-move.move.why.where: Quest "Camera move", step 2 (move): the quiet line under it saying why.

quest.camera-move.move.hint.text: Press inside the camera frame (the box with the dark edge) and drag.
quest.camera-move.move.hint.where: Quest "Camera move", step 2 (move): said when nothing has happened for a while.

quest.camera-move.glide.say.text: Now make it glide: on frame 1, press Ctrl+Shift+T for in-betweens.
quest.camera-move.glide.say.where: Quest "Camera move", step 3 (glide): what the guide says.

quest.camera-move.glide.why.text: Without in-betweens the camera would jump at the last frame. With them it pans smoothly.
quest.camera-move.glide.why.where: Quest "Camera move", step 3 (glide): the quiet line under it saying why.

quest.camera-move.glide.hint.text: Or right-click the camera key on frame 1 in the timeline and choose Make in-betweens.
quest.camera-move.glide.hint.where: Quest "Camera move", step 3 (glide): said when nothing has happened for a while.

quest.camera-move.depth.say.text: Push the Far hills back: in the Camera panel, set their distance to 3.
quest.camera-move.depth.say.where: Quest "Camera move", step 4 (depth): what the guide says.

quest.camera-move.depth.why.text: Far things drift slower than near ones as the camera passes. That is called parallax.
quest.camera-move.depth.why.where: Quest "Camera move", step 4 (depth): the quiet line under it saying why.

quest.camera-move.depth.hint.text: Each layer has a box under "Distance from the camera" in the Camera panel. 0 is right on the stage.
quest.camera-move.depth.hint.where: Quest "Camera move", step 4 (depth): said when nothing has happened for a while.

quest.camera-move.look.say.text: Press Shift+C to look through the camera.
quest.camera-move.look.say.where: Quest "Camera move", step 5 (look): what the guide says.

quest.camera-move.look.hint.text: View > Look through the camera does the same. Press it again to see the whole stage.
quest.camera-move.look.hint.where: Quest "Camera move", step 5 (look): said when nothing has happened for a while.

quest.camera-move.play.say.where: Quest "Camera move", step 6 (play): what the guide says.

quest.camera-move.play.hint.text: The big triangle in the timeline, or press Enter.
quest.camera-move.play.hint.where: Quest "Camera move", step 6 (play): said when nothing has happened for a while.

quest.turn-the-page.title.where: Quest "Turn the page": its name, on the welcome sheet, in the Quests panel and on the Great work card.

quest.turn-the-page.summary.text: Turn the canvas to any angle, the way you turn a sheet of paper, then put it straight again.
quest.turn-the-page.summary.where: Quest "Turn the page": the one friendly sentence under its name, on the welcome sheet and in the Quests panel.

quest.turn-the-page.badge.where: Quest "Turn the page": the name of the badge you earn for finishing it.

quest.turn-the-page.finish.text: Turn it whenever a stroke feels awkward. It only changes how you look at the page, never the drawing or what you export.
quest.turn-the-page.finish.where: Quest "Turn the page": the line on the Great work card once you have finished it.

quest.turn-the-page.turn.say.text: Hold Alt and drag round the middle of the canvas, with the Brush or Pencil. The page turns with your pointer.
quest.turn-the-page.turn.say.where: Quest "Turn the page", step 1 (turn): what the guide says.

quest.turn-the-page.turn.why.text: Painters turn the paper to reach a stroke comfortably. Alt and a plain click still picks a colour on a pixel layer. Hold Shift as you drag to turn in neat 15 degree steps.
quest.turn-the-page.turn.why.where: Quest "Turn the page", step 1 (turn): the quiet line under it saying why.

quest.turn-the-page.turn.hint.text: Press Alt, then drag in a slow circle around the middle of the canvas. Alt and . (full stop) turns it a little too.
quest.turn-the-page.turn.hint.where: Quest "Turn the page", step 1 (turn): said when nothing has happened for a while.

quest.turn-the-page.straight.say.text: Press Straighten on the note at the top of the canvas to put the page back.
quest.turn-the-page.straight.say.where: Quest "Turn the page", step 2 (straight): what the guide says.

quest.turn-the-page.straight.why.text: The note stays while the page is turned, so you never mistake a turned view for a crooked drawing. Ctrl+Shift+0 does the same.
quest.turn-the-page.straight.why.where: Quest "Turn the page", step 2 (straight): the quiet line under it saying why.

quest.turn-the-page.straight.hint.text: It is the button at the top of the canvas.
quest.turn-the-page.straight.hint.where: Quest "Turn the page", step 2 (straight): said when nothing has happened for a while.

quest.make-it-glow.title.where: Quest "Make it glow": its name, on the welcome sheet, in the Quests panel and on the Great work card.

quest.make-it-glow.summary.text: Light up a lantern with a glow, a blend mode and a flicker.
quest.make-it-glow.summary.where: Quest "Make it glow": the one friendly sentence under its name, on the welcome sheet and in the Quests panel.

quest.make-it-glow.badge.where: Quest "Make it glow": the name of the badge you earn for finishing it.

quest.make-it-glow.finish.text: Glow, blend and a flicker: the same three tricks make magic, neon signs and fireflies.
quest.make-it-glow.finish.where: Quest "Make it glow": the line on the Great work card once you have finished it.

quest.make-it-glow.glow.say.text: The Lantern layer is picked. In the Effects panel, add a Glow.
quest.make-it-glow.glow.say.where: Quest "Make it glow", step 1 (glow): what the guide says.

quest.make-it-glow.glow.why.text: An effect changes how a whole layer looks, without touching the drawing. Take it off any time.
quest.make-it-glow.glow.why.where: Quest "Make it glow", step 1 (glow): the quiet line under it saying why.

quest.make-it-glow.glow.hint.text: Under Add an effect at the bottom of the Effects panel, press Glow.
quest.make-it-glow.glow.hint.where: Quest "Make it glow", step 1 (glow): said when nothing has happened for a while.

quest.make-it-glow.size.say.text: Make the glow bigger: drag its Size past 20.
quest.make-it-glow.size.say.where: Quest "Make it glow", step 2 (size): what the guide says.

quest.make-it-glow.size.hint.text: Size is the second slider under Glow.
quest.make-it-glow.size.hint.where: Quest "Make it glow", step 2 (size): said when nothing has happened for a while.

quest.make-it-glow.blend.say.text: Now pick the Light layer and set its blend mode to Add.
quest.make-it-glow.blend.say.where: Quest "Make it glow", step 3 (blend): what the guide says.

quest.make-it-glow.blend.why.text: Add brightens whatever is under it, the way real light does. Normal just covers it up.
quest.make-it-glow.blend.why.where: Quest "Make it glow", step 3 (blend): the quiet line under it saying why.

quest.make-it-glow.blend.hint.text: The blend button is at the top of the Effects panel. It says Normal now.
quest.make-it-glow.blend.hint.where: Quest "Make it glow", step 3 (blend): said when nothing has happened for a while.

quest.make-it-glow.flicker.say.text: Make it flicker: back on the Lantern, turn on Animate for the glow, go to frame 7 and change its Strength.
quest.make-it-glow.flicker.say.where: Quest "Make it glow", step 4 (flicker): what the guide says.

quest.make-it-glow.flicker.why.text: Animated effect settings glide from one key to the next, just like drawings do.
quest.make-it-glow.flicker.why.where: Quest "Make it glow", step 4 (flicker): the quiet line under it saying why.

quest.make-it-glow.flicker.hint.text: The Animate button next to the word Glow turns animating on. Then move the playhead and drag Strength.
quest.make-it-glow.flicker.hint.where: Quest "Make it glow", step 4 (flicker): said when nothing has happened for a while.

quest.make-it-glow.play.say.text: Press play and watch it flicker.
quest.make-it-glow.play.say.where: Quest "Make it glow", step 5 (play): what the guide says.

quest.make-it-glow.play.hint.text: The big triangle in the timeline, or press Enter.
quest.make-it-glow.play.hint.where: Quest "Make it glow", step 5 (play): said when nothing has happened for a while.

quest.particle-party.title.where: Quest "Particle party": its name, on the welcome sheet, in the Quests panel and on the Great work card.

quest.particle-party.summary.text: Throw some confetti, then make it your own.
quest.particle-party.summary.where: Quest "Particle party": the one friendly sentence under its name, on the welcome sheet and in the Quests panel.

quest.particle-party.badge.where: Quest "Particle party": the name of the badge you earn for finishing it.

quest.particle-party.finish.text: Particles are worked out fresh for every frame, so they always look the same when you scrub, play or export.
quest.particle-party.finish.where: Quest "Particle party": the line on the Great work card once you have finished it.

quest.particle-party.add.say.text: Add some confetti: in the Particles panel, press Confetti.
quest.particle-party.add.say.where: Quest "Particle party", step 1 (add): what the guide says.

quest.particle-party.add.why.text: A preset is a starting point. Rain, snow, smoke and sparkles are there too.
quest.particle-party.add.why.where: Quest "Particle party", step 1 (add): the quiet line under it saying why.

quest.particle-party.add.hint.text: Tools and layers > Effects > Add particles: Confetti in the menu does it too.
quest.particle-party.add.hint.where: Quest "Particle party", step 1 (add): said when nothing has happened for a while.

quest.particle-party.motion.say.text: Change how it flies. Drag Gravity, Speed or Spread in the Particles panel.
quest.particle-party.motion.say.where: Quest "Particle party", step 2 (motion): what the guide says.

quest.particle-party.motion.why.text: More gravity and it falls faster. More spread and it fans out wider.
quest.particle-party.motion.why.where: Quest "Particle party", step 2 (motion): the quiet line under it saying why.

quest.particle-party.motion.hint.text: Pick the confetti with the Select tool if the panel says nothing is selected.
quest.particle-party.motion.hint.where: Quest "Particle party", step 2 (motion): said when nothing has happened for a while.

quest.particle-party.colour.say.text: Give it your own colours with the two colour boxes in the Particles panel.
quest.particle-party.colour.say.where: Quest "Particle party", step 3 (colour): what the guide says.

quest.particle-party.colour.why.text: Each piece takes its colour from these two: a mix of them, or one turning into the other as it ages.
quest.particle-party.colour.why.where: Quest "Particle party", step 3 (colour): the quiet line under it saying why.

quest.particle-party.colour.hint.text: The colour boxes are further down the Particles panel.
quest.particle-party.colour.hint.where: Quest "Particle party", step 3 (colour): said when nothing has happened for a while.

quest.particle-party.shuffle.say.text: Press Shuffle for a new random spread with the same settings.
quest.particle-party.shuffle.say.where: Quest "Particle party", step 4 (shuffle): what the guide says.

quest.particle-party.shuffle.hint.text: Shuffle is the button at the top of the Particles panel.
quest.particle-party.shuffle.hint.where: Quest "Particle party", step 4 (shuffle): said when nothing has happened for a while.

quest.particle-party.play.say.where: Quest "Particle party", step 5 (play): what the guide says.

quest.particle-party.play.hint.text: The big triangle in the timeline, or press Enter.
quest.particle-party.play.hint.where: Quest "Particle party", step 5 (play): said when nothing has happened for a while.

quest.shade-and-shine.title.where: Quest "Shade and shine": its name, on the welcome sheet, in the Quests panel and on the Great work card.

quest.shade-and-shine.summary.text: Draw a mirrored blob, shade it with the palette and give it a crisp outline.
quest.shade-and-shine.summary.where: Quest "Shade and shine": the one friendly sentence under its name, on the welcome sheet and in the Quests panel.

quest.shade-and-shine.badge.where: Quest "Shade and shine": the name of the badge you earn for finishing it.

quest.shade-and-shine.finish.text: Shaded, outlined and symmetrical. That is most of pixel art! Try the Dither brush (Shift+B) next for texture.
quest.shade-and-shine.finish.where: Quest "Shade and shine": the line on the Great work card once you have finished it.

quest.shade-and-shine.mirror.say.text: Turn on mirror drawing: press Shift+M.
quest.shade-and-shine.mirror.say.where: Quest "Shade and shine", step 1 (mirror): what the guide says.

quest.shade-and-shine.mirror.why.text: A dashed line appears down the middle. Whatever you draw on one side shows up on the other.
quest.shade-and-shine.mirror.why.where: Quest "Shade and shine", step 1 (mirror): the quiet line under it saying why.

quest.shade-and-shine.outline.say.text: Pick the pencil (P) and draw half a round blob. Watch the other half draw itself.
quest.shade-and-shine.outline.say.where: Quest "Shade and shine", step 2 (outline): what the guide says.

quest.shade-and-shine.outline.hint.text: Make it a closed shape, so the bucket can fill it next.
quest.shade-and-shine.outline.hint.where: Quest "Shade and shine", step 2 (outline): said when nothing has happened for a while.

quest.shade-and-shine.fill.say.text: Fill the inside with the paint bucket (G). It pours the fill colour, a palette green.
quest.shade-and-shine.fill.say.where: Quest "Shade and shine", step 3 (fill): what the guide says.

quest.shade-and-shine.fill.hint.text: Click inside the blob. If the green spills out, undo and close the gap.
quest.shade-and-shine.fill.hint.where: Quest "Shade and shine", step 3 (fill): said when nothing has happened for a while.

quest.shade-and-shine.shade.say.text: Pick Shade (S), choose Darker, and brush along the bottom of the blob.
quest.shade-and-shine.shade.say.where: Quest "Shade and shine", step 4 (shade): what the guide says.

quest.shade-and-shine.shade.why.text: Each pass moves a pixel one step darker along its palette ramp. Bottoms are in shadow.
quest.shade-and-shine.shade.why.where: Quest "Shade and shine", step 4 (shade): the quiet line under it saying why.

quest.shade-and-shine.shade.hint.text: Shade only changes palette colours, so your outline stays as it is.
quest.shade-and-shine.shade.hint.where: Quest "Shade and shine", step 4 (shade): said when nothing has happened for a while.

quest.shade-and-shine.shine.say.text: Now switch Shade to Lighter and dab a highlight near the top.
quest.shade-and-shine.shine.say.where: Quest "Shade and shine", step 5 (shine): what the guide says.

quest.shade-and-shine.shine.hint.text: One or two pixels is plenty. Small highlights read best.
quest.shade-and-shine.shine.hint.where: Quest "Shade and shine", step 5 (shine): said when nothing has happened for a while.

quest.shade-and-shine.edge.say.text: Finish with an outline round the whole thing: Pixel tools menu, then Add outline (outside).
quest.shade-and-shine.edge.say.where: Quest "Shade and shine", step 6 (edge): what the guide says.

quest.shade-and-shine.edge.why.text: It uses the stroke colour. An outline makes a sprite pop on any background.
quest.shade-and-shine.edge.why.where: Quest "Shade and shine", step 6 (edge): the quiet line under it saying why.

quest.one-tiny-picture.title.where: Quest "One tiny picture": its name, on the welcome sheet, in the Quests panel and on the Great work card.

quest.one-tiny-picture.summary.text: Draw a little heart on a 16 by 16 picture, give it a second colour, and export it as a PNG.
quest.one-tiny-picture.summary.where: Quest "One tiny picture": the one friendly sentence under its name, on the welcome sheet and in the Quests panel.

quest.one-tiny-picture.badge.where: Quest "One tiny picture": the name of the badge you earn for finishing it.

quest.one-tiny-picture.finish.text: A whole icon from a handful of pixels! Keep going: a coin, a key, a potion. Quill is cheering.
quest.one-tiny-picture.finish.where: Quest "One tiny picture": the line on the Great work card once you have finished it.

quest.one-tiny-picture.draw.say.text: Draw a little heart with the Pencil. Every click paints one chunky pixel.
quest.one-tiny-picture.draw.say.where: Quest "One tiny picture", step 1 (draw): what the guide says.

quest.one-tiny-picture.draw.why.text: The grid is 16 by 16, so a heart is only a few pixels wide. Wobbly is fine.
quest.one-tiny-picture.draw.why.where: Quest "One tiny picture", step 1 (draw): the quiet line under it saying why.

quest.one-tiny-picture.draw.hint.text: Click and drag over the grid. Paint is the front square at the top of the Palette.
quest.one-tiny-picture.draw.hint.where: Quest "One tiny picture", step 1 (draw): said when nothing has happened for a while.

quest.one-tiny-picture.swap.say.text: Press X to swap Paint and Back. Watch the two big squares at the top of the Palette trade places.
quest.one-tiny-picture.swap.say.where: Quest "One tiny picture", step 2 (swap): what the guide says.

quest.one-tiny-picture.swap.why.text: Paint is the colour you draw with. Back is your second colour, always one key away.
quest.one-tiny-picture.swap.why.where: Quest "One tiny picture", step 2 (swap): the quiet line under it saying why.

quest.one-tiny-picture.back.say.text: Right-click the grid to paint with Back. Dab a few pixels for a shine.
quest.one-tiny-picture.back.say.where: Quest "One tiny picture", step 3 (back): what the guide says.

quest.one-tiny-picture.back.hint.text: Right-click and drag, just like drawing. A trackpad does it with a two finger tap.
quest.one-tiny-picture.back.hint.where: Quest "One tiny picture", step 3 (back): said when nothing has happened for a while.

quest.one-tiny-picture.export.say.text: Open Export and choose PNG picture (it lives under More formats).
quest.one-tiny-picture.export.say.where: Quest "One tiny picture", step 4 (export): what the guide says.

quest.one-tiny-picture.export.why.text: You do not have to save anything: close the window whenever you like.
quest.one-tiny-picture.export.why.where: Quest "One tiny picture", step 4 (export): the quiet line under it saying why.

quest.one-tiny-picture.export.hint.text: File, then Export. PNG picture is the plain still image.
quest.one-tiny-picture.export.hint.where: Quest "One tiny picture", step 4 (export): said when nothing has happened for a while.

quest.board-by-board.title.where: Quest "Board by board": its name, on the welcome sheet, in the Quests panel and on the Great work card.

quest.board-by-board.summary.text: Draw three frames on three boards, play them in order, and export them as a sprite sheet.
quest.board-by-board.summary.where: Quest "Board by board": the one friendly sentence under its name, on the welcome sheet and in the Quests panel.

quest.board-by-board.badge.where: Quest "Board by board": the name of the badge you earn for finishing it.

quest.board-by-board.finish.text: Three boards, one animation! Each board is a frame, and the sheet holds them all in order.
quest.board-by-board.finish.where: Quest "Board by board": the line on the Great work card once you have finished it.

quest.board-by-board.one.say.text: Draw something on Frame 1 with the Pencil. It is the first frame of your animation.
quest.board-by-board.one.say.where: Quest "Board by board", step 1 (one): what the guide says.

quest.board-by-board.one.hint.text: A blob, a face, a ball: anything that can move a little next.
quest.board-by-board.one.hint.where: Quest "Board by board", step 1 (one): said when nothing has happened for a while.

quest.board-by-board.two.say.text: Click Frame 2 in the Artboards panel and draw it a little different.
quest.board-by-board.two.say.where: Quest "Board by board", step 2 (two): what the guide says.

quest.board-by-board.two.why.text: Every frame gets its own board. Tidy!
quest.board-by-board.two.why.where: Quest "Board by board", step 2 (two): the quiet line under it saying why.

quest.board-by-board.two.hint.text: Move something a pixel or two, so it looks like it is moving.
quest.board-by-board.two.hint.where: Quest "Board by board", step 2 (two): said when nothing has happened for a while.

quest.board-by-board.three.say.where: Quest "Board by board", step 3 (three): what the guide says.

quest.board-by-board.play.say.text: Press Play all in order in the Artboards panel, and watch them go.
quest.board-by-board.play.say.where: Quest "Board by board", step 4 (play): what the guide says.

quest.board-by-board.sheet.say.text: Open Export and choose Sprite sheet. Every board becomes one frame.
quest.board-by-board.sheet.say.where: Quest "Board by board", step 5 (sheet): what the guide says.

quest.board-by-board.sheet.hint.text: The Sprite sheet card says "For games".
quest.board-by-board.sheet.hint.where: Quest "Board by board", step 5 (sheet): said when nothing has happened for a while.

quest.cast-on-a-sheet.title.where: Quest "A cast on one sheet": its name, on the welcome sheet, in the Quests panel and on the Great work card.

quest.cast-on-a-sheet.summary.text: Draw a hero and a coin on their own boards, then pack them on one sheet for your game engine.
quest.cast-on-a-sheet.summary.where: Quest "A cast on one sheet": the one friendly sentence under its name, on the welcome sheet and in the Quests panel.

quest.cast-on-a-sheet.badge.where: Quest "A cast on one sheet": the name of the badge you earn for finishing it.

quest.cast-on-a-sheet.finish.text: A whole cast on one sheet, ready for Godot, Unity or Phaser. Add an enemy next!
quest.cast-on-a-sheet.finish.where: Quest "A cast on one sheet": the line on the Great work card once you have finished it.

quest.cast-on-a-sheet.hero.say.text: Draw your hero on the Hero board with the Pencil.
quest.cast-on-a-sheet.hero.say.where: Quest "A cast on one sheet", step 1 (hero): what the guide says.

quest.cast-on-a-sheet.hero.why.text: Every board is a sprite of its own. This one is already named Hero.
quest.cast-on-a-sheet.hero.why.where: Quest "A cast on one sheet", step 1 (hero): the quiet line under it saying why.

quest.cast-on-a-sheet.item.say.text: Click Item in the Artboards panel and draw a coin.
quest.cast-on-a-sheet.item.say.where: Quest "A cast on one sheet", step 2 (item): what the guide says.

quest.cast-on-a-sheet.item.hint.text: A round blob with a shine is a fine coin.
quest.cast-on-a-sheet.item.hint.where: Quest "A cast on one sheet", step 2 (item): said when nothing has happened for a while.

quest.cast-on-a-sheet.sheet.say.text: Open Export and choose Sprite sheet. The boards pack onto one picture, with the data for your engine.
quest.cast-on-a-sheet.sheet.say.where: Quest "A cast on one sheet", step 3 (sheet): what the guide says.

quest.cast-on-a-sheet.sheet.hint.text: The Sprite sheet card says "For games". Pick Godot, Unity, Phaser or PixiJS under it.
quest.cast-on-a-sheet.sheet.hint.where: Quest "A cast on one sheet", step 3 (sheet): said when nothing has happened for a while.

quest.first-animation.summary.text: Draw a doodle, draw it again a little different, that's animation!
quest.first-animation.summary.where: Quest "Your first animation in 60 seconds": the one friendly sentence under its name, on the welcome sheet and in the Quests panel.

quest.first-animation.badge.where: Quest "Your first animation in 60 seconds": the name of the badge you earn for finishing it.

quest.bouncing-ball.summary.text: Take a look inside the classic first exercise, then change its timing.
quest.bouncing-ball.summary.where: Quest "Bouncing ball": the one friendly sentence under its name, on the welcome sheet and in the Quests panel.

quest.bouncing-ball.badge.where: Quest "Bouncing ball": the name of the badge you earn for finishing it.

quest.fill-it-in.title.where: Quest "Fill it in": its name, on the welcome sheet, in the Quests panel and on the Great work card.

quest.fill-it-in.summary.text: Colour a shape with the paint bucket, even when the outline has a gap.
quest.fill-it-in.summary.where: Quest "Fill it in": the one friendly sentence under its name, on the welcome sheet and in the Quests panel.

quest.fill-it-in.badge.where: Quest "Fill it in": the name of the badge you earn for finishing it.

quest.pixel-pal.title.where: Quest "Pixel pal": its name, on the welcome sheet, in the Quests panel and on the Great work card.

quest.pixel-pal.summary.text: Make a tiny two-frame sprite on a chunky pixel grid.
quest.pixel-pal.summary.where: Quest "Pixel pal": the one friendly sentence under its name, on the welcome sheet and in the Quests panel.

quest.pixel-pal.badge.where: Quest "Pixel pal": the name of the badge you earn for finishing it.

quest.tiles.title.where: Quest "Tiles": its name, on the welcome sheet, in the Quests panel and on the Great work card.

quest.tiles.summary.text: Draw a tile that repeats without a seam, then paint a little level with it.
quest.tiles.summary.where: Quest "Tiles": the one friendly sentence under its name, on the welcome sheet and in the Quests panel.

quest.tiles.badge.where: Quest "Tiles": the name of the badge you earn for finishing it.

quest.first-tween.title.where: Quest "Your first tween": its name, on the welcome sheet, in the Quests panel and on the Great work card.

quest.first-tween.summary.text: Draw something once and let Frameling draw all the frames as it glides across.
quest.first-tween.summary.where: Quest "Your first tween": the one friendly sentence under its name, on the welcome sheet and in the Quests panel.

quest.first-tween.badge.where: Quest "Your first tween": the name of the badge you earn for finishing it.

quest.share-it.title.where: Quest "Share it": its name, on the welcome sheet, in the Quests panel and on the Great work card.

quest.share-it.summary.text: See how to turn your animation into a GIF anyone can open.
quest.share-it.summary.where: Quest "Share it": the one friendly sentence under its name, on the welcome sheet and in the Quests panel.

quest.share-it.badge.where: Quest "Share it": the name of the badge you earn for finishing it.

quest.bones-and-pose.title.where: Quest "Bones and a pose": its name, on the welcome sheet, in the Quests panel and on the Great work card.

quest.bones-and-pose.summary.text: Give an arm a skeleton, then wave it by dragging, like a puppet.
quest.bones-and-pose.summary.where: Quest "Bones and a pose": the one friendly sentence under its name, on the welcome sheet and in the Quests panel.

quest.bones-and-pose.badge.where: Quest "Bones and a pose": the name of the badge you earn for finishing it.

quest.say-it-with-text.title.where: Quest "Say it with text": its name, on the welcome sheet, in the Quests panel and on the Great work card.

quest.say-it-with-text.summary.text: Type a word and make its letters pop in and wave.
quest.say-it-with-text.summary.where: Quest "Say it with text": the one friendly sentence under its name, on the welcome sheet and in the Quests panel.

quest.say-it-with-text.badge.where: Quest "Say it with text": the name of the badge you earn for finishing it.

quest.first-animation.finish.text: You made something move. That is the whole trick, everything else is more of it.
quest.first-animation.finish.where: Quest "Your first animation in 60 seconds": the line on the Great work card once you have finished it.

quest.first-animation.draw.say.text: Draw something on the page. A ball, a blob, a very small cat.
quest.first-animation.draw.say.where: Quest "Your first animation in 60 seconds", step 1 (draw): what the guide says.

quest.first-animation.draw.why.text: The brush is already picked for you. An animation is just a few drawings shown one after another.
quest.first-animation.draw.why.where: Quest "Your first animation in 60 seconds", step 1 (draw): the quiet line under it saying why.

quest.first-animation.draw.hint.text: Click and drag on the white page. Anything at all works.
quest.first-animation.draw.hint.where: Quest "Your first animation in 60 seconds", step 1 (draw): said when nothing has happened for a while.

quest.first-animation.next-frame.say.text: Now make the next drawing. Press D to copy this one onto the next frame.
quest.first-animation.next-frame.say.where: Quest "Your first animation in 60 seconds", step 2 (next-frame): what the guide says.

quest.first-animation.next-frame.why.text: Copying gives you something to change a little, which is easier than starting over.
quest.first-animation.next-frame.why.where: Quest "Your first animation in 60 seconds", step 2 (next-frame): the quiet line under it saying why.

quest.first-animation.next-frame.hint.text: The Copy button in the timeline does the same as pressing D.
quest.first-animation.next-frame.hint.where: Quest "Your first animation in 60 seconds", step 2 (next-frame): said when nothing has happened for a while.

quest.first-animation.change.say.text: Change it a little. Move it along, tilt it, add a squiggle.
quest.first-animation.change.say.where: Quest "Your first animation in 60 seconds", step 3 (change): what the guide says.

quest.first-animation.change.why.text: See the faint ghost of the last drawing? That is onion skin. It is switched on so you can see where you came from.
quest.first-animation.change.why.where: Quest "Your first animation in 60 seconds", step 3 (change): the quiet line under it saying why.

quest.first-animation.change.hint.text: Draw one more line on this frame, or select the drawing and drag it a little way along.
quest.first-animation.change.hint.where: Quest "Your first animation in 60 seconds", step 3 (change): said when nothing has happened for a while.

quest.first-animation.play.say.text: Press play and watch it go!
quest.first-animation.play.say.where: Quest "Your first animation in 60 seconds", step 4 (play): what the guide says.

quest.first-animation.play.why.text: Each drawing is held for 2 frames (animators call it "on twos"), and the timeline is trimmed to your drawings, so it loops with no blank frames.
quest.first-animation.play.why.where: Quest "Your first animation in 60 seconds", step 4 (play): the quiet line under it saying why.

quest.first-animation.play.hint.text: The big triangle in the timeline, or press Enter.
quest.first-animation.play.hint.where: Quest "Your first animation in 60 seconds", step 4 (play): said when nothing has happened for a while.

quest.bouncing-ball.finish.text: Squash, stretch and timing: that is most of what makes a ball feel heavy or light.
quest.bouncing-ball.finish.where: Quest "Bouncing ball": the line on the Great work card once you have finished it.

quest.bouncing-ball.open.say.where: Quest "Bouncing ball", step 1 (open): what the guide says.

quest.bouncing-ball.open.why.text: An example is a normal drawing, so you can poke at anything. The original is never touched.
quest.bouncing-ball.open.why.where: Quest "Bouncing ball", step 1 (open): the quiet line under it saying why.

quest.bouncing-ball.open.hint.text: Find the ball card in the examples and press it.
quest.bouncing-ball.open.hint.where: Quest "Bouncing ball", step 1 (open): said when nothing has happened for a while.

quest.bouncing-ball.scrub.say.text: Scrub through it. Press . and , to step a frame at a time, or click along the ruler.
quest.bouncing-ball.scrub.say.where: Quest "Bouncing ball", step 2 (scrub): what the guide says.

quest.bouncing-ball.scrub.hint.text: Click the numbered strip at the top of the timeline and drag.
quest.bouncing-ball.scrub.hint.where: Quest "Bouncing ball", step 2 (scrub): said when nothing has happened for a while.

quest.bouncing-ball.squash.say.text: Find the squashed ball. It is frame 9, right when it hits the ground.
quest.bouncing-ball.squash.say.where: Quest "Bouncing ball", step 3 (squash): what the guide says.

quest.bouncing-ball.squash.why.text: The pink marker called contact is there too. Squashing on impact is what makes it look like it has weight.
quest.bouncing-ball.squash.why.where: Quest "Bouncing ball", step 3 (squash): the quiet line under it saying why.

quest.bouncing-ball.squash.hint.text: Press . until the counter says Frame 9, or click the contact marker.
quest.bouncing-ball.squash.hint.where: Quest "Bouncing ball", step 3 (squash): said when nothing has happened for a while.

quest.bouncing-ball.hold.say.text: Hold this drawing for longer. Pick 2 under "Hold for".
quest.bouncing-ball.hold.say.where: Quest "Bouncing ball", step 4 (hold): what the guide says.

quest.bouncing-ball.hold.why.text: Holding a drawing on twos means it shows for two frames. Longer on the ground feels heavier.
quest.bouncing-ball.hold.why.where: Quest "Bouncing ball", step 4 (hold): the quiet line under it saying why.

quest.bouncing-ball.hold.hint.text: Alt+2 does it from the keyboard. You can undo it afterwards.
quest.bouncing-ball.hold.hint.where: Quest "Bouncing ball", step 4 (hold): said when nothing has happened for a while.

quest.bouncing-ball.play.say.text: Press play and feel the difference.
quest.bouncing-ball.play.say.where: Quest "Bouncing ball", step 5 (play): what the guide says.

quest.fill-it-in.finish.text: Paint goes under your lines, so you can fix a colour later without redrawing a thing.
quest.fill-it-in.finish.where: Quest "Fill it in": the line on the Great work card once you have finished it.

quest.fill-it-in.shape.say.text: Draw a closed shape: a circle, a blob, a house. Join the line up where it started.
quest.fill-it-in.shape.say.where: Quest "Fill it in", step 1 (shape): what the guide says.

quest.fill-it-in.shape.why.text: The bucket fills an area with lines all the way round it. The Ellipse and Rectangle tools always close up.
quest.fill-it-in.shape.why.where: Quest "Fill it in", step 1 (shape): the quiet line under it saying why.

quest.fill-it-in.shape.hint.text: Go all the way round and finish on the spot where you began.
quest.fill-it-in.shape.hint.where: Quest "Fill it in", step 1 (shape): said when nothing has happened for a while.

quest.fill-it-in.bucket.say.where: Quest "Fill it in", step 2 (bucket): what the guide says.

quest.fill-it-in.bucket.hint.text: It is the bucket in the toolbar, or press G.
quest.fill-it-in.bucket.hint.where: Quest "Fill it in", step 2 (bucket): said when nothing has happened for a while.

quest.fill-it-in.fill.say.where: Quest "Fill it in", step 3 (fill): what the guide says.

quest.fill-it-in.fill.why.text: The bucket pours the fill colour: the solid box in the Colours panel. We picked a sunny yellow, but choose any colour you like. The paint tucks in behind the line.
quest.fill-it-in.fill.why.where: Quest "Fill it in", step 3 (fill): the quiet line under it saying why.

quest.fill-it-in.fill.hint.text: If nothing happens, the line may have a gap. The next step is about that.
quest.fill-it-in.fill.hint.where: Quest "Fill it in", step 3 (fill): said when nothing has happened for a while.

quest.fill-it-in.gap.say.text: Try a different "Close gaps" setting in the tool options.
quest.fill-it-in.gap.say.where: Quest "Fill it in", step 4 (gap): what the guide says.

quest.fill-it-in.gap.why.text: A bigger setting fills shapes whose lines do not quite meet. Draw a shape with a small gap, and see which setting copes.
quest.fill-it-in.gap.why.where: Quest "Fill it in", step 4 (gap): the quiet line under it saying why.

quest.fill-it-in.gap.hint.text: The Tool options panel is on the right. Close gaps has None, Small, Medium and Large.
quest.fill-it-in.gap.hint.where: Quest "Fill it in", step 4 (gap): said when nothing has happened for a while.

quest.pixel-pal.finish.text: Two frames of pixel art. Press Enter to watch it, and keep adding frames for a walk or a wave.
quest.pixel-pal.finish.where: Quest "Pixel pal": the line on the Great work card once you have finished it.

quest.pixel-pal.draw.say.text: Draw a small outline with the brush. Every touch paints one chunky pixel.
quest.pixel-pal.draw.say.where: Quest "Pixel pal", step 1 (draw): what the guide says.

quest.pixel-pal.draw.why.text: This page is a 32 by 32 grid. A ring, a heart or a tiny blob is plenty.
quest.pixel-pal.draw.why.where: Quest "Pixel pal", step 1 (draw): the quiet line under it saying why.

quest.pixel-pal.draw.hint.text: Click and drag over the grid. Try to join the line up.
quest.pixel-pal.draw.hint.where: Quest "Pixel pal", step 1 (draw): said when nothing has happened for a while.

quest.pixel-pal.fill.say.text: Pick the paint bucket and click inside your outline.
quest.pixel-pal.fill.say.where: Quest "Pixel pal", step 2 (fill): what the guide says.

quest.pixel-pal.fill.hint.text: On pixel pages the bucket fills every joined pixel of the same colour.
quest.pixel-pal.fill.hint.where: Quest "Pixel pal", step 2 (fill): said when nothing has happened for a while.

quest.pixel-pal.copy.say.text: Make a second frame. Press D to copy your sprite onto the next one.
quest.pixel-pal.copy.say.where: Quest "Pixel pal", step 3 (copy): what the guide says.

quest.pixel-pal.copy.hint.text: The Copy button in the timeline does the same as pressing D.
quest.pixel-pal.copy.hint.where: Quest "Pixel pal", step 3 (copy): said when nothing has happened for a while.

quest.pixel-pal.change.say.text: Change a few pixels so frame 2 looks different.
quest.pixel-pal.change.say.where: Quest "Pixel pal", step 4 (change): what the guide says.

quest.pixel-pal.change.why.text: Two frames is enough for a blink, a wobble or a wave.
quest.pixel-pal.change.why.where: Quest "Pixel pal", step 4 (change): the quiet line under it saying why.

quest.pixel-pal.change.hint.text: Rub out a pixel with the eraser, or paint a new one.
quest.pixel-pal.change.hint.where: Quest "Pixel pal", step 4 (change): said when nothing has happened for a while.

quest.pixel-pal.preview.say.text: Watch your pal play at real size in the Preview panel.
quest.pixel-pal.preview.say.where: Quest "Pixel pal", step 5 (preview): what the guide says.

quest.pixel-pal.preview.why.text: Pixel art looks different small. 1x is how big it will be in a game; click the picture to pause.
quest.pixel-pal.preview.why.where: Quest "Pixel pal", step 5 (preview): the quiet line under it saying why.

quest.pixel-pal.preview.hint.text: The Preview is a panel on the right. View > Panels > Preview opens it.
quest.pixel-pal.preview.hint.where: Quest "Pixel pal", step 5 (preview): said when nothing has happened for a while.

quest.share-it.finish.text: That is all there is to it. Press Export when you are ready, or close this and keep drawing.
quest.share-it.finish.where: Quest "Share it": the line on the Great work card once you have finished it.

quest.share-it.open.say.text: Open Export. Press Ctrl+E (Cmd+E on a Mac), or find it in the File menu.
quest.share-it.open.say.where: Quest "Share it", step 1 (open): what the guide says.

quest.share-it.open.hint.where: Quest "Share it", step 1 (open): said when nothing has happened for a while.

quest.share-it.gif.say.where: Quest "Share it", step 2 (gif): what the guide says.

quest.share-it.gif.why.text: GIFs play in chats and forums. You do not have to save anything: close the window whenever you like.
quest.share-it.gif.why.where: Quest "Share it", step 2 (gif): the quiet line under it saying why.

quest.share-it.gif.hint.text: The cards across the top are the formats. GIF is the one with the picture icon.
quest.share-it.gif.hint.where: Quest "Share it", step 2 (gif): said when nothing has happened for a while.

quest.bones-and-pose.finish.text: Two poses and Frameling moved the arm between them. The Paper doll puppet example has a whole body to play with.
quest.bones-and-pose.finish.where: Quest "Bones and a pose": the line on the Great work card once you have finished it.

quest.bones-and-pose.add.say.text: Press Draw bones in the Rig panel.
quest.bones-and-pose.add.say.where: Quest "Bones and a pose", step 1 (add): what the guide says.

quest.bones-and-pose.add.why.text: Bones live on a layer of their own, on top. The Bone tool (K) gets picked for you.
quest.bones-and-pose.add.why.where: Quest "Bones and a pose", step 1 (add): the quiet line under it saying why.

quest.bones-and-pose.add.hint.text: It is in the Rig panel on the right, or Frames and motion > Skeleton (rig) > Add a skeleton to this drawing in the menu.
quest.bones-and-pose.add.hint.where: Quest "Bones and a pose", step 1 (add): said when nothing has happened for a while.

quest.bones-and-pose.draw.say.text: Drag from the shoulder to the elbow, then from the elbow to the hand.
quest.bones-and-pose.draw.say.where: Quest "Bones and a pose", step 2 (draw): what the guide says.

quest.bones-and-pose.draw.why.text: Start the second bone on the tip of the first and it hangs from it, like a real arm.
quest.bones-and-pose.draw.why.where: Quest "Bones and a pose", step 2 (draw): the quiet line under it saying why.

quest.bones-and-pose.draw.hint.text: Press where the arm joins, drag to the bend, and let go.
quest.bones-and-pose.draw.hint.where: Quest "Bones and a pose", step 2 (draw): said when nothing has happened for a while.

quest.bones-and-pose.attach.say.text: Press Shift+A to attach each part to the bone over it.
quest.bones-and-pose.attach.say.where: Quest "Bones and a pose", step 3 (attach): what the guide says.

quest.bones-and-pose.attach.why.text: Attached parts follow their bone around. You can change which bone each part follows in the Rig panel.
quest.bones-and-pose.attach.why.where: Quest "Bones and a pose", step 3 (attach): the quiet line under it saying why.

quest.bones-and-pose.attach.hint.text: Frames and motion > Skeleton (rig) > Attach parts to bones does the same.
quest.bones-and-pose.attach.hint.where: Quest "Bones and a pose", step 3 (attach): said when nothing has happened for a while.

quest.bones-and-pose.pose.say.text: The Pose tool (Shift+K) is picked. Go to frame 13 and drag the hand up for a wave.
quest.bones-and-pose.pose.say.where: Quest "Bones and a pose", step 4 (pose): what the guide says.

quest.bones-and-pose.pose.why.text: A pose on a new frame makes a key. The frames in between glide from one pose to the next.
quest.bones-and-pose.pose.why.where: Quest "Bones and a pose", step 4 (pose): the quiet line under it saying why.

quest.bones-and-pose.pose.hint.text: Click 13 on the ruler first, then drag the hand with the Pose tool.
quest.bones-and-pose.pose.hint.where: Quest "Bones and a pose", step 4 (pose): said when nothing has happened for a while.

quest.bones-and-pose.play.say.text: Press play and watch it wave!
quest.bones-and-pose.play.say.where: Quest "Bones and a pose", step 5 (play): what the guide says.

quest.bones-and-pose.play.hint.text: The big triangle in the timeline, or press Enter.
quest.bones-and-pose.play.hint.where: Quest "Bones and a pose", step 5 (play): said when nothing has happened for a while.

quest.first-tween.finish.text: Smooth! Try Draw a path in Symbol and motion next, to send it along a curve.
quest.first-tween.finish.where: Quest "Your first tween": the line on the Great work card once you have finished it.

quest.first-tween.draw.say.text: Draw something on the page: a ball, a star, a paper plane.
quest.first-tween.draw.say.where: Quest "Your first tween", step 1 (draw): what the guide says.

quest.first-tween.draw.why.text: You only draw it once. Frameling does the rest.
quest.first-tween.draw.why.where: Quest "Your first tween", step 1 (draw): the quiet line under it saying why.

quest.first-tween.draw.hint.text: Click and drag on the white page.
quest.first-tween.draw.hint.where: Quest "Your first tween", step 1 (draw): said when nothing has happened for a while.

quest.first-tween.tween.say.where: Quest "Your first tween", step 2 (tween): what the guide says.

quest.first-tween.tween.why.text: In-betweens are the frames between two poses. Animators call them tweens.
quest.first-tween.tween.why.where: Quest "Your first tween", step 2 (tween): the quiet line under it saying why.

quest.first-tween.tween.hint.text: You can also right-click the drawing in the timeline and choose Make in-betweens.
quest.first-tween.tween.hint.where: Quest "Your first tween", step 2 (tween): said when nothing has happened for a while.

quest.first-tween.move.say.text: This is the last frame. Drag your drawing somewhere else, so it has somewhere to go.
quest.first-tween.move.say.where: Quest "Your first tween", step 3 (move): what the guide says.

quest.first-tween.move.why.text: You can resize it with the corners or turn it with the round handle too.
quest.first-tween.move.why.where: Quest "Your first tween", step 3 (move): the quiet line under it saying why.

quest.first-tween.move.hint.text: With the Select tool, drag the drawing to the right.
quest.first-tween.move.hint.where: Quest "Your first tween", step 3 (move): said when nothing has happened for a while.

quest.first-tween.ease.say.text: Pick how it moves. Try Bouncy in the Easing list.
quest.first-tween.ease.say.where: Quest "Your first tween", step 4 (ease): what the guide says.

quest.first-tween.ease.why.text: Easing is how it speeds up and slows down. Watch the dots on the canvas bunch up where it goes slowly.
quest.first-tween.ease.why.where: Quest "Your first tween", step 4 (ease): the quiet line under it saying why.

quest.first-tween.ease.hint.text: The Easing list is in the Symbol and motion panel.
quest.first-tween.ease.hint.where: Quest "Your first tween", step 4 (ease): said when nothing has happened for a while.

quest.first-tween.play.say.text: Press play and watch it glide!
quest.first-tween.play.say.where: Quest "Your first tween", step 5 (play): what the guide says.

quest.first-tween.play.hint.text: The big triangle in the timeline, or press Enter.
quest.first-tween.play.hint.where: Quest "Your first tween", step 5 (play): said when nothing has happened for a while.

quest.say-it-with-text.finish.text: Text stays text, so you can fix a typo any time and the animation just follows. The Title card example has more.
quest.say-it-with-text.finish.where: Quest "Say it with text": the line on the Great work card once you have finished it.

quest.say-it-with-text.type.say.text: The Text tool is picked. Click the page and type a word, then press Esc.
quest.say-it-with-text.type.say.where: Quest "Say it with text", step 1 (type): what the guide says.

quest.say-it-with-text.type.why.text: Text stays editable: double-click it later to change the words.
quest.say-it-with-text.type.why.where: Quest "Say it with text", step 1 (type): the quiet line under it saying why.

quest.say-it-with-text.type.hint.text: Press T for the Text tool if it got switched off.
quest.say-it-with-text.type.hint.where: Quest "Say it with text", step 1 (type): said when nothing has happened for a while.

quest.say-it-with-text.animate.say.text: Make it pop in: in the Text panel, under "Animate the letters", press Grow.
quest.say-it-with-text.animate.say.where: Quest "Say it with text", step 2 (animate): what the guide says.

quest.say-it-with-text.animate.why.text: Each letter grows in a moment after the one before. Animators call it kinetic type.
quest.say-it-with-text.animate.why.where: Quest "Say it with text", step 2 (animate): the quiet line under it saying why.

quest.say-it-with-text.animate.hint.text: If the Text panel is empty, click your text with the Select tool (V) first.
quest.say-it-with-text.animate.hint.where: Quest "Say it with text", step 2 (animate): said when nothing has happened for a while.

quest.say-it-with-text.wave.say.text: Add a Wave as well, so the letters keep bobbing after they land.
quest.say-it-with-text.wave.say.where: Quest "Say it with text", step 3 (wave): what the guide says.

quest.say-it-with-text.wave.why.text: Animations stack. Each one has its own start, length and order.
quest.say-it-with-text.wave.why.where: Quest "Say it with text", step 3 (wave): the quiet line under it saying why.

quest.say-it-with-text.wave.hint.text: Wave is in the same row of buttons, next to Typewriter.
quest.say-it-with-text.wave.hint.where: Quest "Say it with text", step 3 (wave): said when nothing has happened for a while.

quest.say-it-with-text.play.say.text: Press play and read all about it.
quest.say-it-with-text.play.say.where: Quest "Say it with text", step 4 (play): what the guide says.

quest.say-it-with-text.play.hint.text: The big triangle in the timeline, or press Enter.
quest.say-it-with-text.play.hint.where: Quest "Say it with text", step 4 (play): said when nothing has happened for a while.

quest.tiles.finish.text: A seamless tile and a level made of it. Add more tiles (grass, walls, water) and export the lot for your game with File, Export tileset.
quest.tiles.finish.where: Quest "Tiles": the line on the Great work card once you have finished it.

quest.tiles.make.say.text: Make a tile: in the Tileset panel, press + (New tile).
quest.tiles.make.say.where: Quest "Tiles", step 1 (make): what the guide says.

quest.tiles.make.why.text: A tile is a small square picture, like a patch of grass. You draw it once and use it everywhere.
quest.tiles.make.why.where: Quest "Tiles", step 1 (make): the quiet line under it saying why.

quest.tiles.open.say.text: Double-click your tile to draw it. Tile mode comes on: the tile repeats all round.
quest.tiles.open.say.where: Quest "Tiles", step 2 (open): what the guide says.

quest.tiles.open.why.text: Tile mode (Shift+T) shows copies on every side, so you can see where the edges meet.
quest.tiles.open.why.where: Quest "Tiles", step 2 (open): the quiet line under it saying why.

quest.tiles.open.hint.text: If it is open but not repeating, press Shift+T to turn tile mode on.
quest.tiles.open.hint.where: Quest "Tiles", step 2 (open): said when nothing has happened for a while.

quest.tiles.edge.say.text: Pick the pencil (P) and draw a line off the right edge. Watch it carry on from the left.
quest.tiles.edge.say.where: Quest "Tiles", step 3 (edge): what the guide says.

quest.tiles.edge.why.text: Drawing wraps round in tile mode, so the edges always match. That is a seamless tile.
quest.tiles.edge.why.where: Quest "Tiles", step 3 (edge): the quiet line under it saying why.

quest.tiles.edge.hint.text: Start near the middle and drag straight past the edge of the tile. Top to bottom works too.
quest.tiles.edge.hint.where: Quest "Tiles", step 3 (edge): said when nothing has happened for a while.

quest.tiles.done.say.text: Press Done above the canvas (or Ctrl+Enter) to put the tile back.
quest.tiles.done.say.where: Quest "Tiles", step 4 (done): what the guide says.

quest.tiles.layer.say.text: Add a tilemap layer: Tools and layers menu, then Add a tilemap layer.
quest.tiles.layer.say.where: Quest "Tiles", step 5 (layer): what the guide says.

quest.tiles.layer.why.text: A tilemap layer is a grid you paint with tiles instead of colours. Game levels are made of them.
quest.tiles.layer.why.where: Quest "Tiles", step 5 (layer): the quiet line under it saying why.

quest.tiles.stamp.say.text: With the tile brush (B), click a few times on the canvas to stamp your tile.
quest.tiles.stamp.say.where: Quest "Tiles", step 6 (stamp): what the guide says.

quest.tiles.stamp.why.text: Drag to paint a row. Change the tile later and every copy changes with it.
quest.tiles.stamp.why.where: Quest "Tiles", step 6 (stamp): the quiet line under it saying why.

quest.tiles.stamp.hint.text: Three tiles is enough. Side by side they join up with no seam.
quest.tiles.stamp.hint.where: Quest "Tiles", step 6 (stamp): said when nothing has happened for a while.
